scams.name: Digital Arrest / Fake Law Enforcement
scams.description: Scammers impersonate police, CBI, ED, or customs officials claiming an illegal parcel or Aadhaar criminal involvement, placing the victim under fake 'video surveillance' arrest.
typical_script_lines: A courier parcel in your name contains narcotics / fake passports
Your Aadhaar is linked to 14 money laundering accounts in Mumbai
You must remain on continuous Skype / WhatsApp video call under digital arrest
Transfer verification deposit to the RBI secret clearing account
scams.safe_response: Real police or CBI never conduct arrests or investigations over video calls. Hang up and report immediately to cybercrime portal 1930.

scams.name: Fake Bank KYC & Account Block Threat
scams.description: SMS or call claiming your bank account, SIM card, or PAN has been suspended due to pending KYC.
typical_script_lines: Dear customer, your SBI / HDFC account has been blocked due to incomplete KYC
Click here immediately to update PAN or account will be permanently deactivated
Call customer care executive at this number to avoid netbanking suspension
scams.safe_response: Banks never send SMS with third-party APK links or phone numbers. Check account status only inside your official bank app.

scams.name: Electricity Bill Disconnection Threat
scams.description: Urgent SMS threatening that your electricity will be disconnected tonight due to an unpaid bill.
typical_script_lines: Dear Consumer, your electricity power will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM
Your previous month bill was not updated. Immediately call electricity officer at [PHONE]
scams.safe_response: Power utility boards never send disconnect threats from personal mobile numbers. Verify bill history only on the official electricity discom portal.

scams.name: Search Engine Fake Customer Care
scams.description: Fraudulent phone numbers posted on Google Maps / Search impersonating airline, courier, or refund customer care.
typical_script_lines: I am calling from courier refund support department
To process your Rs 50 refund, please install this support app (AnyDesk / TeamViewer)
Please accept the 9-digit connection code on your mobile
scams.safe_response: Never install remote screen-sharing tools like AnyDesk, TeamViewer, or QuickSupport on request of anyone.

scams.name: Lottery, KBC & Prize Fraud
scams.description: Claims that victim won Rs 25 Lakhs in Kaun Banega Crorepati or a lucky draw, demanding advance tax or processing fees.
typical_script_lines: Congratulations! Your WhatsApp number has won Rs 25,00,000 in KBC Lucky Draw
To release your prize cheque, pay Rs 12,500 government clearance tax
scams.safe_response: Legitimate lotteries never ask winners to pay advance fees or processing charges before claiming prizes.

scams.name: High-Return Part-Time & Stock Investment Lure
scams.description: WhatsApp or Telegram groups offering guaranteed 300% returns or daily income by liking YouTube videos and trading on fake crypto portals.
typical_script_lines: Work from home: Earn Rs 3,000 to Rs 8,000 daily by simply reviewing hotels
Exclusive VIP Institutional Stock Trading group with guaranteed 50% weekly returns
scams.safe_response: Any scheme promising guaranteed high returns with zero risk is a financial trap. Never send money to personal UPI accounts for trading.

scams.name: Relative or Child in Emergency
scams.description: Urgent distress call impersonating a grandson, child, or acquaintance claiming hospital emergency or police custody.
typical_script_lines: Grandpa, please don't tell mom! I was caught in a car accident and police need bail money right now
I am calling on behalf of your son from hospital, transfer Rs 40,000 immediately for surgery
scams.safe_response: Always hang up and call your relative directly on their known personal phone number before sending money.

scams.name: Parcel Held in Customs
scams.description: Foreign parcel or gift package allegedly held at airport customs requiring customs duty clearance.
typical_script_lines: A gift parcel containing foreign currency and gold jewelry is held at Mumbai Airport customs
Pay customs clearance charge of Rs 35,000 to avoid legal action
scams.safe_response: Customs departments never request duty payments into personal individual bank or UPI accounts.

scams.name: Work From Home & Overseas Job Offer
scams.description: Fake appointment letters demanding registration fees, document processing fees, or laptop security deposits.
typical_script_lines: You are selected for Data Entry / Airline ground staff position
Deposit Rs 4,500 refundable training and badge fee
scams.safe_response: Reputable employers never demand upfront security deposits or training fees from candidates.

scams.name: Malicious App / APK File Download
scams.description: WhatsApp message containing an APK file disguised as a wedding card, bill invoice, or bank update.
typical_script_lines: Wedding_Card_Invitation.apk
Install this government subsidy application to receive Rs 2,000 credit
scams.safe_response: Never click or install .apk files received via WhatsApp or SMS. Only install applications from the official Google Play Store or Apple App Store.
